children: Monroe Federal Bancorp’s net interest income rose 7.6% year over year, while noninterest income fell 34.0%. The net loss narrowed primarily on higher net interest income and a recovery of credit losses, partly offset by lower noninterest income and a smaller income tax benefit.
: Increased to 2.92% from 2.65%; net interest rate spread rose to 2.70% from 2.45%.
: Net loans increased $3.0M, or 2.7%, to $113.5M from March 31, 2026, driven by demand for commercial real estate lending.
: Deposits rose $6.5M, or 5.2%, to $131.0M from March 31, 2026; core deposits increased $2.5M, or 3.0%.
: The company recorded a $16,000 recovery of credit losses, compared with an $11,000 provision in the year-earlier quarter.
